ppo.reward: terminal feasible-front HV under frozen training-only normalization; no step reward
ppo.selection: 18 validation instances, configuration-equal paired absolute HV difference vs update 0; ties earlier

training_schedule: round-robin S0-S8; 32 trajectories give 3 or 4 per configuration; freeze order before outcomes
joint_c_m_order: C previews paired Base-mutated candidates without evaluation, selects the pre-mutation pair; restores RNG; normal M stage executes once on selected children
reporting: per-instance union min/max of all five methods and all seeds, reference 1.1; report training-normalization results separately; conditional development intervals
scope: small all-configuration development confirmation; no automatic extra seeds or retuning
